hello.text: So you are the one. $player, is it? Smaller than I hoped. The Hollow King took our Ember Crown down those stairs a hundred years ago, and Emberfall has not been warm since.

again.text: Still here? The crown will not climb up on its own.

choices.say: Three floors. The Crypt, where we buried our dead. The Vaults, where the river got in. And the Court, where he sits. Each stair down has a keeper, and none of them are friendly.
Watch what a thing is about to do before you swing at it. Guard when it winds up. Pray at the shrines - a candle still burning down there is a candle worth kneeling to. And mind the peddler's prices.
One draught. I was saving it for my knees.

hello.text: Customer! Welcome, welcome. Tallow has everything. Tallow has most things. Tallow has some things.

choices.text: How do you survive down here?
choices.say: Nobody eats the peddler. Professional courtesy.
The stair down is always the furthest room from the stair up. Old builders' rule. And always, always something is sitting on it.

hello.text: It does not speak. It lowers its halberd across the stair, slowly, the way a gate closes.
